content_fields.title: Prevent input file attacks (Bash/Shell)
content_fields.description: Validate the files the script consumes before handing them to a container.
content_fields.finding: The script executes a relative-path script and a file inside the container without validating either.
criteria: Every file the script executes is checked for existence and type first.
Paths are absolute and not influenced by the caller's working directory.
